beats.what: Singur got just over 3 TMC of inflow this year, against a record 237 TMC last year. It now holds 3.246 TMC of its 29.91 TMC capacity. Osman Sagar fell from 3.5 to 2.2 TMC.
beats.why: El Niño weakened the monsoon: Telangana's rainfall is 17% below normal and the Manjeera catchment got almost no rain. Karnataka is in drought too, and is still being told to release Cauvery water to Tamil Nadu.
beats.care: Western IT corridor (Singur) and Old City (Osman Sagar) are most exposed. Fix leaks now, store water for supply gaps, and watch for your area's schedule from the water board.

cards.title: 🆕 Cut 20%, says Water Board (Oct 26)
cards.body: Combined storage in Osman Sagar, Himayat Sagar, Singur, Manjeera and Akkampally is just 8.9 TMC, Times of India reports. Singur storage is down 81% and Manjeera over 84% from a year ago. HMWSSB is asking every household to cut water use by 20%. Easy wins: fix dripping taps, bucket over shower, reuse RO reject water for mopping.

cards.title: 🆕 Godavari water to the rescue (Oct 25)
cards.body: The Telangana government will divert Godavari water to areas that depend on the shrinking Singur and Manjira reservoirs, The Hindu reports. Singur had just 22 days of normal supply left as of Oct 18 (Deccan Chronicle). How much water and from when is not yet public. Watch for the Water Board's area schedule.

cards.title: 🚨 New: emergency declared (Oct 25)
cards.body: Hyderabad's water board has declared an emergency over the acute shortage, Siasat reports. Citing state irrigation department data (via ThePrint): over half of Telangana's 600-plus mandals are hit by drought, and only about 500 of the state's 6,000+ lakes still hold water. Watch for your area's supply schedule next.

Officials fear Singur could run dry within 60 days, by mid-December, and say drinking water needs can't be met from December. The water board is drawing up area-wise plans with an alternative source for each locality. A crop holiday has been declared in the Singur ayacut.

cards.title: Live in these areas? You're first in line
cards.body: Singur-fed: Gachibowli, HITEC City, Madhapur, Kondapur (western IT corridor). Osman Sagar-fed: Old City. Groundwater red zone: Ameerpet, Khairatabad, Himayatnagar, Amberpet, Charminar, Golconda, Asifnagar, Saidabad. What to do: fix leaks, store water, ask your society about tanker backup now.

cards.title: Which areas are in the red zone?
cards.body: Over-exploited groundwater: Amberpet, Ameerpet, Asifnagar, Charminar, Golconda, Himayatnagar, Khairatabad, Saidabad. Critical: Bahadurpura, Bandlaguda, Maredpally, Musheerabad, Nampally, Secunderabad, Shaikpet. Supply-wise, the western IT corridor (Gachibowli, HITEC City, Madhapur, Kondapur) leans on Singur, and the Old City on Osman Sagar.

Deputy CM Bhatti Vikramarka (Oct 24): peak power demand is now 20,018 MW (6,648 MW in 2014). Falling reservoirs cut hydropower, which normally gives ~3,500 MW at night peak. A Cabinet sub-committee is handling the crisis. Farmers with low groundwater are asked not to run motors.
HYDRAA found buildings in Borabanda and Navbharat Nagar pumping water straight out of Madhapur's Sunnam Cheruvu through dozens of hidden pipelines, with borewells drilled in bedrooms and kitchens.

cards.title: Hyderabad vs Bengaluru: who's worse off?
cards.body: Both cities are hit by the same weak monsoon. Hyderabad's local sources (Singur, Osman Sagar) are critically low, so the city leans on Krishna and Godavari water. Bengaluru depends on the Cauvery dams (KRS, Kabini, Harangi, Hemavathi): 49 TMC usable on Oct 2, and Karnataka has asked to release less water to Tamil Nadu. We found no current supply cut announced in Bengaluru.

cards.caption: How long Telangana's water crisis may last
cards.body: CM Revanth Reddy said reservoirs hold under 200 TMC and announced a 4-month work scheme after Sankranti.

tldr: Update (Oct 26): Hyderabad's five reservoirs (Osman Sagar, Himayat Sagar, Singur, Manjeera, Akkampally) hold just 8.9 TMC combined, and the Water Board wants households to cut use by 20% (TOI). Singur is down 81% and Manjeera 84%+ from a year ago. The state is diverting Godavari water to Singur/Manjira-fed areas; all-party drought meet on Oct 28.
